meta.keys: cells maps each farmland square id to a key in records; the values are records[cells[id]]
meta.what: change by 2041-2060 against 2001-2020 in each model (historical run to 2014, then SSP2-4.5; temperatures and day counts: difference; rain: % change). Projected value for a square = its typical value in cells_weather.json + this change (for rain: x (1 + change/100)).
meta.low_typical_high: 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile across the climate models

hot.what: hot days (30 °C or more) from 15 April to 15 June

nex_gddp_cmip6.name: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 daily downscaled climate projections
nex_gddp_cmip6.licence: CC0 1.0 (blanket licence for all NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 outputs since September 2022)
nex_gddp_cmip6.cite: Thrasher, B. et al. (2022). NASA Global Daily Downscaled Projections, CMIP6. Scientific Data 9: 262. doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01393-4

meta.ai_assistance: Produced by notebooks written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) and run by the Field Shift team in Google Colab with Google Earth Engine. Data values come from the cited datasets and were not written by the AI, except a few published values from the trial at the demo field (its station's rain and temperature, and its soil description), which were copied by hand from Denora et al. (2025) and are labelled as such.
